translations.web: All the men of his house, those born in the house, and those bought with money from a foreigner, were circumcised with him.
translations.bsb: And all the men of Abraham’s household—both servants born in his household and those purchased from foreigners—were circumcised with him.
translations.kjv: And all the men of his house, born in the house, and bought with money of the stranger, were circumcised
